title: 指数自动降级链 + Report.Degraded
description: internal/prism: Report 加 Degraded 字段;lixinger 分派失败且 FallbackSource=akshare 时当场兜底,成功记 Degraded 并计入 Refreshed,双败 Failed 含两原因。规格以计划 Task 5 为准。

functional: 主源败+兜底成: Failed 空、Refreshed 计入、Degraded 含 symbol 与主源失败原因、兜底行已落库
Degraded 元素格式断言实覆盖: assert.Contains 分别断 "lixinger failed" 与 "akshare fallback ok" 两段格式串
boundary: 主源成功→不触碰 akshare(零多余请求,capture 断言)
error_handling: 双源皆败→Failed 单条含两个失败原因,Degraded 空

non_functional.desc: 既有理杏仁/engine/akshare 用例全部无回归
